description: Hugging Face Text Generation Inference 3.3.7 Docker controls. TGI is upstream maintenance only.

flags.label: Port
flags.help: The port apps use on your computer. TGI listens inside Docker on port 80; the launcher maps this port to it.

flags.label: Maximum context and reply tokens
flags.help: Maximum tokens in one request, including prompt and reply. Leave empty for TGI to use the model limit. Longer requests need more GPU memory.

flags.label: Maximum prompt tokens
flags.help: Largest prompt TGI accepts. It must be smaller than maximum context and reply tokens, leaving room for the answer.

flags.label: Number of GPUs
flags.help: Split one model across this many GPUs. Leave empty to let TGI use all visible GPUs.

flags.label: GPU memory usage limit
flags.help: Limits the share of GPU memory TGI may allocate. Lower it if other programs need VRAM; that leaves less room for the model and conversation.

flags.label: Concurrent requests
flags.help: Maximum number of simultaneous requests. Keep it low on personal hardware to avoid excess memory use.

flags.label: Batch token budget
flags.help: Total tokens TGI can keep active across requests. Leave empty for automatic sizing; raising it uses more GPU memory.

flags.label: Conversation memory precision
flags.help: 8-bit cache can use less VRAM than the model's normal precision. Hardware and model support vary; leave empty unless memory is tight.

flags.label: Allow model's custom code
flags.help: Permit code supplied by the model publisher to run locally. Enable only for a publisher you trust.

flags.label: API key (password)
flags.help: Require this key from clients. Recommended when local network access is enabled.

flags.label: Listen address
flags.help: The address on your computer that Docker exposes. The launcher uses loopback unless local network access is enabled in Settings.

flags.label: GPU numbers
flags.help: NVIDIA GPU numbers to expose to Docker, separated by commas, such as 0,1. Leave empty for all GPUs.

flags.label: Hugging Face token
flags.help: Needed only for gated models. The token is passed to Docker through a private temporary file.

flags.label: Extra raw flags
flags.help: Additional TGI launcher options for experienced users. The launcher passes these to the container unchanged.
